shortDescription: The FTSE MIB Index decreased 68 points or 0.13 percent on Thursday to close at 51807 points.The decline was led by Moncler (-2.93%), Avio (-2.74%) and Buzzi Unicem (-2.71%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Lottomatica (4.68%), Leonardo SpA (3.22%) and Infrastrutture Wire (2.49%).
